# Preview Accessibility Checklist: Integration Preview Visibility

**Purpose**: Review whether the requirements completely and unambiguously govern visual preview contrast, nonvisual fallbacks, responsive behavior, portability, and identity preservation.
**Created**: 2026-09-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all directly previewable and nonvisual delivery classes explicitly distinguished? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for every issue-mandated fixture class rather than only the named failing cards? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the identity properties that must remain unchanged enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 Are direct-file portability requirements documented separately from hosted presentation requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the precedence between declared appearance and measured visible output unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Is meaningful graphical content tied to a quantitative contrast floor and rendered-size evaluation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the nonvisual-resource treatment distinct from an image-preview or failed-preview claim? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the required browser matrix explicit about width, zoom, surface theme, and direct portable output? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do preview visibility requirements remain consistent with the prohibition on recoloring or otherwise mutating assets? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK010 Do grouped-delivery requirements preserve both the visual representative and nonvisual sibling semantics? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK011 Do fixture requirements align with the constitution's prohibition on committed synthetic brand data? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Assumption]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Can every graphical and textual contrast outcome be objectively measured against its stated threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Can nonvisual treatment coverage be counted across every governed nonvisual class? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Can preservation be demonstrated through byte and hash evidence without byte-comparing regenerated PDF or PNG presentation artifacts? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK015 Are production verification and glyph-validation completion signals quantified as zero failures? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are dark, light, transparent, mixed-tone, and fully transparent visual outcomes addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Are absent, generic, stale, and insufficient appearance declarations addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are unsupported or malformed preview inputs required to fail clearly or receive intentional nonvisual treatment? [Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are narrow viewport and 200 percent zoom requirements sufficient to expose clipping, overlap, and reflow failures? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-011]

## Dependencies and Safety

- [ ] CHK020 Is the shared generator identified as the governed correction boundary while generated output remains excluded? [Dependency, Spec §FR-013, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK021 Are applicable safety requirements scoped to local asset handling, escaped labels, destination integrity, and synthetic-fixture isolation? [Security, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK022 Is deterministic classification required for identical bytes and metadata? [Reliability, Spec §FR-016]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
